entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received last month. I need to return a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the AeroPro Helmet, delivered on December 24th, 2025. That was 32 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The color looked different online, and it doesn't match my bike aesthetics. The box is completely unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself.
I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important, especially for something as critical as safety equipment. Let me just check our return policy for you.

Alright, I've pulled it up. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery for items in their original condition. Since you received it 32 days ago and the box is unopened, you are unfortunately outside that window. I've just approved the return for you.
Excellent, thank you, Charlie. I'll be sending that back and ordering the correct color.
You're welcome. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label and instructions now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.

That's very efficient. Now, since I am buying the replacement helmet from VeloFit immediately, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my new order? Say, 10% for the trouble of the return process?

I'm glad I could get that return sorted for you. I appreciate you choosing us for your replacement helmet. Unfortunately, I'm not authorized to generate discount codes for this type of situation. However, I can confirm that once we receive the original item, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
I see. No discount, then. It was worth asking. Alright, I have the email with the label. Thanks for your help today.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
